honesty.proposed: Districts, programmes and organisations named here are PROPOSED: no district, programme or organisation has reviewed or agreed, and no agreement, grant or funding exists.
honesty.un: The UN path is a PROPOSED module of this game, not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations.
honesty.not_accredited: Nothing here is accredited and nothing certifies anybody. Lessons are unverified general practice.
honesty.play: Games, coins and badges are play: kept on the device, never a completion record, never money.

districts.text: district names are public-record identities only; every record is a PROPOSED partner - no district has reviewed or agreed, and no agreement exists

cognitionx.text: Cognition.X blocks are curriculum statements with transfer checks, quoted verbatim. They are not accredited, not a standards alignment, and not verified or reviewed by SmartCiti.X.

standards.text: No grade-level standards alignment is claimed; the K-12 bands are the schools pack's own bands, quoted.

rules.play_safe: a lesson is play-safe when its title, why and limits contain no word on the hive k12 hold list; a Cognition.X block when its theme, description and transfer check contain none; an agent line when its text contains none. Held items are counted, never reworded.
rules.band_fold: a Cognition.X band joins the schools band whose grade range contains it (K = 0).
rules.program_order: 1 the allow-listed Hive agents (advisors, then parish figures, hive order); 2 courses carrying play-safe lessons for the band (courses registry order, lessons in course order); 3 classroom modules whose lessons stand in the band (classroom order); 4 Cognition.X modules with play-safe blocks in the folded bands (cognitionx order).
rules.cards: one card per band and classroom module of that band; a simulator seat is listed only when the band admits sims. What a class does = the band offer, then the schools unit home and class drill when the band admits stations, the floor sims when it admits sims, and the gate when the offer names the unaided verification gate.
rules.greeter: the allow-listed k12-guide standing in the lowest-FIPS parish among the module places (lowest id); with none, the campus Orientation guide at the hall door. The line is the first play-safe greeting, say or knowledge line, in that order. In classroom mode the voice starts muted.
rules.sectors: community health = the Smiles district; disaster response = respond/ frames, the halls they touch and the responder figures; humanitarian training = the parish UN training (PROPOSED) and Disaster relief paths and their trainer and relief roles; environmental restoration = restoration/ sites and scenarios, their trade needs and crews. Courses are the trade courses of those halls.

cognitionx.name: Water, storm and the civic machine

first.theme: Where a claim was born

quotes.text: This is a scaffold: role taxonomy, competency domains, scenario frames and debrief structures. It is not a protocol and contains no procedure, no drug, no dose, no triage cut-off, no vital-sign threshold, no tactical technique and no flow, pressure or air figure. 8 patterns for exactly those things are scanned over the finished registry and the build fails on any of them. Where a reader wants the real requirement, every one of the 117 items names the body that owns it.

Nothing in this pack has been reviewed by a serving firefighter, a police officer, a paramedic, an emergency manager or a licensed social worker. Not one of the 117 training items carries a sign-off - the number is 0 of 117 - and it must not be used as the basis of any real certification, qualification, hiring decision or operational procedure.

IAFF, FOP, NAGE, AFSCME, SEIU, NASW and the other bodies named across the 5 services are real organizations. They are named here as TYPES of organization and by the role they play in a workforce. No local, lodge, chapter, council or bargaining unit number appears anywhere in this pack, no officer or member is named, and none of these organizations has reviewed, approved or endorsed any part of this - the endorsement count is 0 of 5 services.
